! About
|-
|
The Consumer Rights Wiki is creating a comprehensive repository of information on anti-consumer practices, one edit at a time. We document both traditional issues such as product safety scandals along with modern problems like subscription traps, dark patterns, and the existing and proposed laws that govern them across the globe.

You don't need an account to read or edit, but [[Special:CreateAccount|creating one]] lets you organize your edits, and more easily interact with the community!
